parameters.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $excel=$null; $wb=$null; try { $excel=New-Object -ComObject Excel.Application; $excel.Visible=$false; $excel.DisplayAlerts=$false; $wb=$excel.Workbooks.Open('\ENDERECO-AQUI\relatorios\COLETAS- 2026.xlsx',0,$true); $result=[System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new(); for($i=1;$i -le $wb.Worksheets.Count;$i++){ $ws=$wb.Worksheets.Item($i); $last=$ws.UsedRange.Row+$ws.UsedRange.Rows.Count-1; for($r=1;$r -le $last;$r++){ $dt=[string]$ws.Cells.Item($r,6).Text; $dtValor=[string]$ws.Cells.Item($r,6).Value2; $cliente=[string]$ws.Cells.Item($r,9).Text; $nota=[string]$ws.Cells.Item($r,23).Text; if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($dt) -or -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($cliente) -or -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($nota)){ $result.Add([PSCustomObject]@{Aba=$ws.Name; Linha=$r; DT=$dt.Trim(); DTValor=$dtValor.Trim(); Cliente=$cliente.Trim(); Nota=$nota.Trim()}) } }; [void][Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($ws) }; ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($result) -Compress -Depth 3 } finally { if($wb){$wb.Close($false); [void][Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($wb)}; if($excel){$excel.Quit(); [void][Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($excel)}; [GC]::Collect(); [GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers() }"
